GET /v1/levels.response: Versioned GameData excluding solutions for competitive sessions

request.startGate: Player-selected letter for solve_both levels; fixed letter otherwise
request.finishGate: Player-selected letter for solve_both levels; fixed letter otherwise

ranking: Independent runs before assisted runs, then verified duration, then move count. Ties share rank.
validation: Server owns rules, run timestamps, ordered actions, hint and pause policy, replay validation, nonce consumption and ranking. Device scores are local practice only.
implementationStatus: Contract and repository boundaries only. No remote endpoint deployed; no fabricated online rankings.
rules: Validate legal port pairs, obstacle events including repeats and empty branches, selected endpoints, and full sequence progress. Never validate against a saved hint layout.
